enroll.title: Enrol Home Assistant on the device
enroll.description:
Home Assistant generated its own key for this device. In the {app} app, open the admin key management screen and add this public key:

`{public_key}`

Fingerprint: `{fingerprint}`

Grant only what Home Assistant needs: do **not** grant admin rights. Then submit to verify — nothing is actuated during the check.

If you remove this integration later, also remove this key in the app: Home Assistant can't revoke it on its own.

error.not_enrolled: The device doesn't accept this key yet. Add the public key above in the app, then try again.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect — make sure the device is powered and in Bluetooth range

abort.no_devices_found: No devices found in Bluetooth range
abort.reauth_successful: The new key was enrolled successfully
